notes: Document layout (the default) with <!--BREAK-->. A marker on its own line starts a page (DBAFTER); a marker followed by an H1 is one break (Third H1); a marker in a code fence and in inline code breaks nothing; two markers in a row are one break (DBPAIR); a marker with nothing after it breaks nothing and leaves no empty page (the last line of the file, after DBEND99); H1s do not break in this layout (Second H1 stays on the title's page).
